svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: macOS · Gallery · batch mode — Auto rename & tag, the review list · 1310×800
svg.desc: Mirrors App/AutoRenameReviewList.swift (AutoRenameReviewList, AutoRenameReviewRow, AutoRenameReviewPanel) + App/AutoRenameReview.swift (AutoRenameReviewSession, AppModel.applyAutoRename) + App/GalleryView.swift (gridColumn / paneColumn while `review` is set) + App/AI/AutoRenameEngine.swift — gallery.batch.svg's window after the batch panel's "Auto rename & tag ×3 selected" row (2026-09-16; Steven's brief and his own drawing of this file were the spec, implemented the same day and tidied to the tokens after). THE LIST takes the grid's place, in place — not a sheet, not a window — under the same selection header (Done cancels the review first; Select All is disabled while it runs, since the rows ARE the selection as it was entered). One row per selected project in the grid's order: the tile as the grid draws it (ring, circle, type badge, clip count), then "Suggested name — edit it or leave it" 11.5 pt over a 32 pt field (14 semibold, 358 wide) — empty means keep the existing name, which is how a row is tagged without renaming — SUBJECT TAGS as the tag editor in its PROPOSED style (accent 13 %, LL.accentDeep text, an xmark each, + Add tag raising gallery.tags.svg's picker; no fractions and no partial state, because a row is one project and a tag is on it or not), FROM THIS CAPTURE as read-only chips (mappin place, sun.horizon light) with "Read from location and time, not the image" once on the first row, and top right Accept (levelGood tick) and Discard (levelFar cross), 28 pt. Row 1 wears the RENAMING marker (amber 35 %, 10.5 semibold deep accent) because that project already carries a name a person chose — Apply all never silently overwrites deliberate naming. Row 3 is PENDING: a small spinner and "Looking at this one…", skeleton field and pills on primary 6 %, the capture chips already there (metadata needs no model), Accept disabled, Discard live (it cancels that row's analysis). Rows stream in as their analysis lands, two at a time (Gemma one at a time). Accept writes that row and collapses it after a beat; Discard collapses it and writes nothing; when the list empties by any mix of the two the grid returns with the selection intact. THE PANEL (the 330 pt pane, 14 pt inset): "3 projects" 16 bold, "Names and tags below apply only to the row they sit on." 12 pt secondary, a divider, Cancel (dashed accent capsule 128×40) and Apply all (filled, 130×40, a tick), then the readiness line — "2 of 3 ready." plus "Apply all uses what is finished and leaves the rest untouched." while rows are pending, or "One couldn't be read." Apply all writes every ready row as ONE undo action ("Auto rename & tag (N projects)", ⌘Z in the Gallery; a single accept is "Auto rename & tag") and cancels the rest; Cancel writes nothing. STATES NOT DRAWN: a failed row ("Couldn't read this one" + Retry, the capture chips under it); the accepted beat (the tick stays green as the row collapses); the compact layout (the list full width with the panel as a bar under it — iPhone, unmirrored). ENGINE: Stage A analyses the frame behind the tile once and keeps the record as Projects/<id>/scene-analysis.json (keyed by asset + frame + schema, so a second run — here, from the single panel, from the project screen — costs no second pass); Stage B generates the name and the tags from it, reconciled against the library's tags (exact, case- and diacritic-insensitive → a small alias table → new, minted only on accept). Above 50 selected the row refuses with an alert naming the cap. Hooks: LL_TAB=gallery LL_SELECT=<uuid>,<uuid>,<uuid> LL_AUTORENAME=demo (these three states, no model) | 1 (the real engine); LL_KEY=cmd+z@16 undoes. Verified 2026-09-16 on the Mac Debug build over a scratch library, Gemma and cache hits alike. Drawn at the 1310×800 window like its siblings; the running app was captured at 1800×1125.
